from itertools import permutations

slots = [(1, 7), (1, 9), (2, 7), (2, 9), (3, 8)]
movies = ["H", "M", "R", "S", "W"]

sols = []
for p in permutations(range(5)):
    pos = {m: slots[p[i]] for i, m in enumerate(movies)}
    t = lambda m: pos[m][1]
    s = lambda m: pos[m][0]
    if not t("W") < t("H"): continue
    if s("S") == 3: continue
    if s("R") == 2: continue
    if s("H") == s("M"): continue
    if not t("R") < t("W"): continue
    sols.append(pos)

print("valid schedules:", len(sols))
for x in sols:
    print(x)

opts = {
    "A": lambda x: x["H"][0] == 1,
    "B": lambda x: x["M"][1] == 7,
    "C": lambda x: x["M"][0] == 2,
    "D": lambda x: x["S"][1] == 9,
    "E": lambda x: x["S"][0] == 2,
}
must = [k for k, f in opts.items() if sols and all(f(x) for x in sols)]
for k, f in opts.items():
    print(k, "holds in", sum(f(x) for x in sols), "of", len(sols))
print("must be true:", must)
print("CHECK PASS" if must == ["D"] else "CHECK FAIL")
